Component 4 - Project Management and Implementation Support. Activities under this component

[Context: Component 4 - Project Management and Implementation Support. Activities under this component]
relate to the institutional support and capacity development for project management and implementation.
Activities include training, staffing, and development activities associated with project execution, such as
consulting services and engineering support. The activities under this component do not have specific or
direct impacts on populations but are critical to the implementation of the project.
